name: YOLOV10-L
notes: Cordatus Inference Engine 2.7.2. One recorded 1080p20 office clip replayed over RTSP to every camera; the camera count was raised until a camera fell under 15 FPS or dropped more than 2% of its frames. Clocks locked at maximum with jetson_clocks and the VIC (video scaler) clock pinned to its maximum: left on its default governor the VIC stayed at 115 MHz and capped every Jetson pipeline near 100 FPS in total.
